title: Speech research, then a little exploring.
summary: Poster conversations, conference sessions and moments from the Netherlands.
paragraphs: INTERSPEECH 2025 in Rotterdam, Netherlands brought together the research and travel parts of this trip. The photographs capture the venue, my poster and the conversations around it.

The most memorable part was interacting with people who stopped at my poster. Explaining the paper and answering their questions made the work feel like a conversation. I especially valued the input and feedback they shared about the research.
After the conference sessions, I spent time visiting places nearby and exploring beyond the venue. Those moments became another part of the experience, alongside the research discussions.
Related research: Heart Rate as a Proxy Measure to Assess Human Confidence in Spoken Speech.
